newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hyundai Motor plans car JV in Brazil.
newsitem.headline: Hyundai Motor plans car JV in Brazil.

text.p: Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, South Korea's largest car maker, said on Friday it plans to build a joint-venture plant in Brazil with an annual capacity of 30,000 compact cars.
"The plant will be a bridgehead into Latin America," said a Hyundai Motor spokesman.
He said the company's honorary chairman Chung Se-yung and president Park Byung-jai would visit Brazil next week to settle details of the project.
Hyundai is currently negotiating with several Brazilian companies, he said. But he declined to name any of the possible partners.
The Hyundai Group earlier said it would invest about $700 million to build a plant in a Latin American country to make 100,000 cars and commercial vehicles a year.
The company's spokesman could not give reasons why the investment plan was scaled down.
